mapper.select: SELECT id, ds_id, db_type, biz_action, normalized_sql, sql_fingerprint, involved_tables, sample_questions, freq, accuracy, knowledge_source, confidence, verified, evidence, status, version, hit_count, error_count, create_time, update_time FROM kb_sql_template WHERE ds_id = #{dsId} AND status <> 'deprecated' AND involved_tables LIKE CONCAT('%', '"', #{tableName}, '"', '%') ORDER BY confidence DESC
